label: Gross receipts filing threshold
note: Taxpayers with less than $350,000 of Michigan apportioned or allocated gross receipts do not file or pay CIT (does not apply to insurers and financial institutions).
source_title: Michigan Department of Treasury: CIT Filing Requirements

label: Levied by
value: The State, cities, villages, townships, counties, school districts, intermediate school districts, special districts, community colleges and authorities
note: Local units set most millages; the State levies the 6-mill State Education Tax.
source_title: Michigan Senate Fiscal Agency: State Notes, Spring 2016, Property Tax Millage Limits (PDF)

label: Annual taxable value increase cap
value: Lesser of the rate of inflation or 5%; resets to state equalized value when ownership transfers
source_title: Michigan Senate Fiscal Agency: The Basics of School Funding (December 2023, PDF)

label: State Education Tax (state property tax)
note: Levied by the State on all real and personal property; revenue goes to the School Aid Fund.
source_title: Michigan House Fiscal Agency: State of Michigan Revenue, Source and Distribution (December 2024, PDF)

section: Michigan property tax: state rules: figures under review
label: State oversight
value: Michigan State Tax Commission (Department of Treasury)
note: General supervision of property tax administration and of local assessors (MCL 209.104).

label: State real estate transfer tax rate
note: $3.75 per $500 (or fraction) of total value (1993 PA 330); revenue goes to the School Aid Fund.

label: County real estate transfer tax rate
